violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points
violation_type.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed have exposed pinch, crush, or shear points, on or underneath it. It was observed nails and bolts out of the wood and plastic parts.

finding_variants.text: All outdoor equipment observed have exposed pinch, crush, or shear points, on or underneath it. It was observed nails and bolts out of the wood and plastic parts.
The wooden firetruck on the playgound has broken areas on both sides of the structure that could cause injuries to the children.

During walk through of the playground, in the toddler play structure a hole with sharp edges was observed. Operation will not be able to play on the structure until repairs are made and proved by licensing.
Three plastic play structure on the playground were observed with cracks in the plastic.      This was corrected at inspection when the director removed these items from the playground.
Round barrel play structure has 3 large long cracks on top. The plastic is rotted from the sun and weather exposure.

During an inspection of the playground, it was observed the merry-go-cycle had two broken seats. This was discussed with the director and a plan was put in place to keep the children off until the equipment is fixed.
